name: Polygon Assisted Ray Casting
aliases: Empty Space Skipping via Volumetric Clipping
Empty space skipping via the volumetric clipping
Hybrid Space Leaping with Graphics Hardware
definition: An optimization for primary rays in volumetric ray tracing using graphics hardware. It creates a polygonal representation of all objects and projects them into two Z-buffers: one for nearest distance and one for farthest distance.
summary: Polygon Assisted Ray Casting accelerates volumetric rendering by using an external polygonal mesh to skip empty space, unlike methods relying on the volume's own alpha tests.
